"How do we stop developers from building everything from scratch?"

I hear this objection constantly. Teams waste months building custom internal tooling when they should be shipping product. 

At this session, I’ll show you how agentic workflows and modern developer platforms change the math. I’ll walk through how we integrated autonomous agents into our CI/CD pipeline to automate environment provisioning. We saw a 40% reduction in onboarding time because the platform "just worked" without manual configuration.

The lesson is clear: don't just build a platform for humans. Build a platform for agents to inhabit. When you provide the right hooks and APIs, agents can handle the heavy lifting of infrastructure management.

We’ll dive into the specific architecture we used, the common pitfalls of agentic orchestration, and how you can start implementing these patterns today to reclaim your engineering velocity.
